title: Jargon and the Ethics of Clarity
text:
Specialised communities develop a shared vocabulary that allows their members to speak quickly and exactly. A structural engineer's 'load path' or a physician's 'differential diagnosis' conveys a great deal in a few words, yet outsiders may hear only obscurity. The difficulty is not that jargon is deliberately exclusive, but that its economy depends on assumptions that are rarely stated aloud.

Experienced practitioners therefore make a point of translating their terms when speaking to the public. A good translation does not water down the idea; it reveals the reasoning that the term compresses. When a specialist can unpack a phrase without losing its meaning, the audience gains understanding, and the expert gains a check on whether they truly grasp the concept themselves.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does a physician's 'differential diagnosis' do?
options: Conveys a great deal in a few words

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do experienced practitioners make a point of doing when speaking to the public?
What does the passage imply about the difficulty that outsiders face with jargon?
options: It is deliberately designed to exclude them
It rests on assumptions that are rarely stated aloud
It appears only in legal documents
It is always simpler than everyday speech

questions.text: Why might an expert gain a check on their own understanding by translating a term?
options: Because translation removes the need for thought
Because being able to unpack a phrase shows whether the expert truly grasps the concept
Because the public always corrects specialists
Because technical terms have no meaning

vocabulary.definition: specialised vocabulary used by a particular profession or group
packs a large amount of meaning into a small space
the identification of an illness or problem from its signs and symptoms
to explain in full the meaning that a term contains

paragraph_translations: የተለየ ሙያ ያላቸው ማኅበረሰቦች አባሎቻቸው በፍጥነትና በትክክል እንዲናገሩ የሚያስችል የጋራ ቃላት ያዳብራሉ። የመዋቅር መሐንዲስ «load path» ወይም የሐኪም «differential diagnosis» በጥቂት ቃላት ብዙ ነገር ያስተላልፋሉ፤ ነገር ግን ከውጭ ያሉ ሰዎች ግልጽ ያልሆነ ነገር ብቻ ሊሰሙ ይችላሉ። ችግሩ ልዩ ቃላት ሆን ብለው ማግለላቸው አይደለም፤ ይልቁንም ቁጠባቸው ብዙ ጊዜ በግልጽ የማይነገሩ ግምቶችን ይመሰረታል።
ልምድ ያላቸው ባለሙያዎች ስለዚህ ለሕዝብ ሲናገሩ ቃላቶቻቸውን ለመተርጎም ይጥራሉ። ጥሩ ትርጉም ሐሳቡን አያሳንስም፤ ቃሉ የሚያጠቃልለውን ምክንያት ይገልጣል። ባለሙያው ሐረግን ትርጉሙን ሳያጣ ማብራራት ሲችል ተመልካቹ ይገነዘባል፤ ባለሙያው ራሱም ጽንሰ-ሐሳቡን በእርግጥ እንደሚረዳ ማረጋገጫ ያገኛል።
